item.description: ### Fixed - **Settings kept in a dotfiles folder stay linked.** If your `~/.claude/settings.json` (or Codex, Cursor or Devin config) is a symlink into a dotfiles repo, Perch replaced the link with a plain file, so your dotfiles copy stopped receiving changes. Perch now writes through the link and leaves it in place. - **Your own hooks next to Perch's are kept.** A hook command you added in the same group as Perch's, in Claude Code or Devin, was deleted the next time Perch updated its hooks or you removed the integration. Only Perch's own entries are touched now. - **Perch works from a folder with a space in its name.** With the app at a path like "Perch 2.app", every hook and the Claude status line failed and sessions showed "Hooks not firing". - **The status line keeps working after you move Perch.** Opening Perch first from the disk image or Downloads and then moving it to Applications left Claude's status line pointing at the old location, and usage, cost and context went blank.
